## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (generated code is compiled and, where relevant, executed)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Documentation is updated (README, `docs/`, diagnostics table)
- [ ] Commit messages (or the squash title) follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), so the change reaches the changelog
- [ ] Generated output stays deterministic, and no generated or user files are written outside the output directory
